mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate borrowing and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods following low FEDFUNDS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the periods when UNRATE exceeds 10%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates stronger economic demand, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods following a 5% YoY increase in HOUST, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production combined with rising retail sales suggests strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods when both INDPRO and RSAFS increase, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in non-farm payroll employment suggests a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods following a 0.5% MoM increase in PAYEMS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth indicates a healthy economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods when GDPC1 is positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate combined with high unemployment suggests a recovery phase, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is low and UNRATE is high, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods following a 0.5% MoM increase in INDPRO, the hypothesis is rejected.
